title: Gang scheduling: per-pod placement deadlocks two jobs; Kueue admits one whole job
purpose: Leave 16 free GPUs in rack b1-r1 and submit two 12-pod jobs (one GPU per pod) at the same time, first straight to the scheduler, then through a Kueue queue with a 16-GPU quota. Distributed training needs all 12 workers.

steps.display: kubectl apply -f filler.yaml   # 2 pods x 8 GPUs in rack b1-r1: 16 of its 32 GPUs remain free
kubectl apply -f gang-a.yaml -f gang-b.yaml   # no queue: every pod goes straight to the scheduler; parallelism 2 of 12
kubectl -n nokueue get jobs   # after raising both to parallelism 12 in alternating steps of 2
pods of each job after 40 s
accounting /now: GPUs waiting for a gang
kubectl apply -f gang-a.yaml -f gang-b.yaml   # labelled kueue.x-k8s.io/queue-name: gangs (ClusterQueue quota 16 GPUs)

steps.output:
WORKLOAD           ADMITTED   PENDING
job-gang-a-1df3d   True       Quota reserved in ClusterQueue cq-gang
job-gang-b-e54e5   False      couldn't assign flavors to pod set main: insufficient unused quota for nvidia.com/gpu in flavor fake-h100-plain, 8 more needed

steps.display: pods of each job after admission

checks.description: without admission both jobs start part of their pods and neither has all 12: a deadlock that holds GPUs
checks.because: The scheduler places each pod alone as GPUs are free; both jobs take part of the 16 and wait for the rest.

checks.description: with Kueue one job is admitted whole (12 pods running) and the other holds nothing until it fits; no GPU waits for a gang
checks.because: Kueue admits a workload only if its whole request fits the quota; the second one stays suspended with no pods.
